metadata.title: driverharvest
metadata.description: This script was created to harvest drivers to be used for Operating System Deployment. You must execute this script before installing any drivers to get a baseline of drivers already installed on the system. After you've run the script to get the baseline driver list, install all missing drivers. Run this utility again to gather all new drivers. The script will compare the baseline against the second harvest and separate out only the new drivers into a 'New-Drivers' Folder. These are the drivers that will need to be imported into SCCM.
